correctness.rationale: The proof reduces all claims to the classical 27 exceptional-curve classes on a general-position six-point blowup, gives four explicit disjoint families of sixers comprising 2+30+20+20=72, and describes the complementary-six involution explicitly. Exact integer-intersection exhaustive enumeration checks all 296010 six-subsets, constructs all 36 double-sixes, and checks all 720 S6 permutations. The 11 orbit profiles, 2+f(f-1)+2u3 and 1+u2+u3 fixed counts, and transposition swapped-half rule agree with independent cycle-union reasoning. Contracting a rational sixer yields a Severi–Brauer plane, which splits by the vanishing of Br(Fq). The conclusion is conditional on specified general-position blowup and does not infer universal field realizability.

value.rationale: Rational blowdowns of smooth cubic surfaces are natural arithmetic-geometric structures; their existence and counts are not determined by the number of individually rational lines. The complete Frobenius action on 72 sixers and 36 double-sixes across all eleven six-point cycle types determines rational contraction choices and zeta functions of these marking schemes over every extension. The six-cycle has no rational exceptional line yet two rational contraction markings; three transposition cycles yield three stable double-sixes with exchanged halves. This is a finite complete classification of a motivated intrinsic marking invariant, not an arbitrary single numerical slice.
